wins.text: FMI technology touched ~44% of revenue in Q4 2024, up from 42% and 39% in prior 2 years; broke 100 MAU signings per day for the first time
Contract base grew double digits, including up 12% in December; monthly daily sales rate exceeded historical sequential in 3 of last 5 months
Industrial Services broke $100 million in revenue for the first time in 2024
Generated $1.2 billion in operating cash for full year 2024, or 102% of net income; raised quarterly dividend by ~10% to ~$1.72 annualized
E-procurement grew ~37.6% YoY; combined e-business and FMI technology touched ~62% of sales; Onsite signings of 358 in 2024 vs. 326 in 2023

risks.text: Q4 2024 daily sales growth of only 2.1%; EPS of $0.46 down ~2% YoY; operating margin declined 120 bps to 18.9% due to slow growth deleverage and holiday shutdowns
Gross margin down 70 bps to 44.8% from product/customer mix, higher container costs on fasteners, and expedited shipments; SG&A up to 25.9% of sales from 25.3%
35% of vending-equipped facilities effectively shut down over the holiday period in 2024 vs. 30% in 2023 and 25% in 2022, signaling deepening industrial economy weakness

PMI remained sub-50% throughout 2024; nonresidential construction down 4.1% and reseller down 11.3% in Q4; January start impacted by New Year's and winter storms forcing cancellation of 6% of truck routes through Jan 10
Potential tariff headwinds on imported goods (particularly fasteners); accelerated ~$10M of inventory ahead of potential new tariffs, adding balance sheet risk

guidance_items.detail: Net CapEx guided to $265M–$285M in 2025, up from $214M in 2024 and prior range of $235M–$265M; expected to be 3%–3.5% of sales over next few years
Gross margin expected to be roughly flat YoY in 2025; product margin pressures from Q4 (container costs, expedited shipments) expected not to recur in Q1 2025
Incremental operating margin expected at high end of 20%–25% range if mid-to-high single-digit revenue growth materializes; leverage expected above mid-single-digit growth
FMI MAU signings goal set at 28,000–30,000 for 2025 vs. 28,000 signed in 2024; digital footprint target raised to 66%–68% of sales from ~62% in 2024

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: tariff pass-through mechanics and contract structure with customers
operating expense trajectory and labor cost leverage thresholds for 2025
customer sales concentration risk (80/20 dynamic) and strategic implications for smaller customer buckets
